# My Bifrost App

An app built on Bifrost Foundation. It reads items: one item's price and inventory, or a
capped list of items.

## Message types
| Type | Effect | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `MyApp.Hello.Get` | Read-only | Hello World: greeting, user, company and app version. Call it first. |
| `MyApp.Item.Summary.Get` | Read-only | One item's description, base unit, unit price and inventory as of a date. |
| `MyApp.Item.List` | Read-only | Items by number filter, at most 100 rows, with the total count. |
| `Help.MyApp.Get` | Read-only | This overview. |

For the contract of any one type, call `Help.Implementation.Get` with its name.

response.markdown:
# Bifrost Reference

A sample app built on Bifrost Foundation. Each message type shows one pattern a partner app
needs: reading a record, validated writes with safe retries, a preview/apply pair for a bulk
change, an external HTTP call with a secret. The data it writes is sample data only.

## Message types
| Type | Effect | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Reference.GLAccount.Overview.Get` | Read-only | A G/L account's balance as of a date and its net change for a period. |
| `Reference.AssetMaintenance.Create` | Commits | Logs maintenance work on a fixed asset; safe to retry with externalId. |
| `Reference.ItemPrice.PreviewAdjustment` | Read-only | Shows a % unit price change for an item category. |
| `Reference.ItemPrice.ApplyAdjustment` | Commits | Applies that change; needs the preview's itemCount. |
| `Reference.ExchangeRate.Get` | Read-only (internet) | Latest ECB rate between two currencies. |
| `Reference.ApiKey.Set` | Commits | Stores the rates API key as a secret. |
| `Reference.Echo.Get` | Read-only | Returns what you sent plus the server time. A connectivity check. |
| `Reference.Table.Get` | Read-only | Returns a table's object ID from its name. |
| `Reference.Note.Add` | Commits | Stores one note under a number you choose. |
| `Help.Reference.Get` | Read-only | This overview. |

For the contract of any one type, call `Help.Implementation.Get` with its name.

response.markdown:
# Legacy App

Stock reservations per item, with a cancellation log. The same rules apply as in the
app's own pages; questions a person answers there are explicit parameters here.

| Type | Effect | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Legacy.Stock.Get` | Read-only | Reserved and still-available quantity of one item. |
| `Legacy.Stock.List` | Read-only | All reservations or those matching an item filter, with count. |
| `Legacy.Stock.Reserve` | Commits | Adds to an item's reservation; refuses over stock unless `allowOverStock`. Not safe to repeat. |
| `Legacy.Stock.CancelReservation` | Commits | Cancels one item's reservation. Safe to repeat. |
| `Legacy.Stock.ReleaseAll` | Commits, irreversible | Releases every reservation matching a filter; needs `expectedCount` from List. |
| `Help.Legacy.Get` | Read-only | This overview. |

For the contract of any one type, call `Help.Implementation.Get` with its name.
